series.label: RSV — hospitalizations per 100,000, ages 0-<6 months (RESP-NET, MN catchment)
series.note: Weekly laboratory-confirmed RSV-associated hospitalizations per 100,000 residents aged 0-<6 months in Minnesota's Emerging Infections Program catchment area (CDC RSV-NET, crude rate). CDC's Minnesota catchment was the 7-county Twin Cities metro through the 2023-24 season and roughly statewide from the 2024-25 season (week ending 2024-10-05), as implied by the published infant rates; rates before and after that week cover different populations. Rates for one age group in one state rest on few patients and can jump week to week. CDC publishes rates to one decimal, so 0.0 means under 0.05 per 100,000, not necessarily zero admissions. The newest two weeks are incomplete and are usually revised upward.
